# Data Dictionary 

conf_cases: number of confirmed cases per week
weekdate: first day of the week being reported
week: week of the year (1-52)
year: year
temp_avg: average weekly temperature measured at 2 meters (C)
temp_max: maximum weekly temperature measured at 2 meters (C)
temp_min: minimum weekly temperature measured at 2 meters (C)
precip_total: total weekly precipitation (mm)
humidity_avg: average weekly relative humidity at 2 meters (%)
